catalog.limit_note: OpenAI public guidance says many or long skill descriptions can be shortened; no numeric catalog token limit was found in the public docs reviewed. Any configured threshold is a local early-warning value, not a product limit.

automatic.detail: Skill name and description guide automatic selection.

explicit.detail: User-requested skills stay model-loadable. Descriptions and instructions recognize natural-language requests; slash/dollar commands are optional. Recognition is model-guided, not an enforced permission boundary.

supporting.detail: There is no native supporting-only restriction; AGENTS.md and owning-skill instructions provide guidance.
supporting.fallback: Treat supporting status as routing guidance, not an enforced permission boundary.
